title: Billing invoice PDF shows incorrect VAT number
description: Our accounting department noticed that the EU VAT registration number on invoice #INV-2026-081 is truncated to 7 digits instead of 9. We need this corrected for our tax filing this Friday.

title: Webhook delivery failing with 504 Gateway Timeout
description: Outbound webhooks sent to https://api.partner.io/events have been timing out intermittently since 06:00 UTC. Approximately 18% of events are failing delivery.

title: Slack notifications stopped firing after OAuth refresh
description: We re-authenticated our workspace Slack app yesterday afternoon, and ticket creation notifications are no longer appearing in our #support-triage channel.

title: User cannot reset password via magic link
description: One of our team managers is unable to access her account. The password reset magic link expires immediately upon clicking, giving an 'Invalid token' alert.

title: Feature Request: Add CSV export for monthly audit logs
description: For SOC2 compliance audits, we need an automated or one-click CSV export option for all security logs and agent ticket modifications over a selected calendar month.

title: Dark mode contrast issues on ticket analytics graph
description: When switching the dashboard to dark theme, the secondary lines on the resolution time chart blend into the slate background and are hard to read.

title: Two-factor authentication lockout after device migration
description: Employee replaced their phone and lost access to their Google Authenticator seed. Backup codes were saved on the old device. Requesting an identity check and MFA reset.

title: SSO/SAML configuration documentation needs update
description: The Okta integration guide in the docs portal references Okta Classic UI fields rather than the newer Okta Identity Engine workflow.

title: Stripe payment retry loop triggered for subscription #8492
description: Our credit card on file was replaced, but the automated billing system attempted charge #8492 four times in 10 minutes, triggering fraud protection flags with our bank.

title: Typo in checkout confirmation page header
description: The order receipt screen says 'Your Subsciption has been updated' with a missing 'r'. Small copy fix needed.

title: Bulk ticket status update returns 413 Payload Too Large
description: When selecting 75 tickets simultaneously and changing status to 'Resolved', the API throws a 413 error and aborts the transaction without partial completion.

title: Mobile Safari responsiveness glitch on ticket details view
description: On iOS 18 Safari, the priority badge overlaps the timestamp header when the viewport width is below 380px.

title: Zapier integration token expiring prematurely after 24h
description: Our Zapier connection requires daily manual re-connection because the refresh token rotation fails to store the updated refresh secret.

title: Request to increase API rate limit for enterprise tier
description: We are preparing for our Black Friday sales campaign and expect API traffic to jump from 120 req/min to 600 req/min during peak hours.

title: Automated weekly digest emails being marked as spam by Outlook
description: Several customers using Office365 enterprise email reported that the weekly summary email is arriving in Junk folders due to an unaligned DKIM signature on the sub-domain.

title: Search query indexing slow for non-ASCII characters
description: Searching for customer names with umlauts or accented letters (e.g., 'Björn', 'Renée') takes over 3 seconds and occasionally misses matching tickets.

title: Customer requesting GDPR data export for account #1048
description: User has invoked their Right to Data Portability under Article 20 of GDPR. Please provide an export of all tickets and chat histories linked to this customer account.

title: Notification sound plays even when tab is muted in Chrome
description: The audio chime for incoming urgent tickets triggers HTML5 audio playback despite browser sound permissions being set to mute.

title: File attachment upload fails for PNGs larger than 10MB
description: High resolution screen captures uploaded by clients fail with an unhandled exception rather than an informative size limit error message.

title: Incorrect timezone offset displayed in agent activity feed
description: When agents in Melbourne (AEST) view logs, timestamps show UTC without the +10:00 conversion applied, causing chronological confusion.

title: Intercom widget conflicts with custom dashboard modal z-index
description: When the Create Ticket modal opens, the third-party chat bubble floats above the backdrop and blocks the submit button on 1366x768 screens.

title: Error 500 when filtering tickets by custom date range
description: Selecting February 29th on a non-leap year or an invalid date string causes the backend SQL query parser to crash with an unhandled DateTime error.

title: Missing confirmation dialog when permanently closing tickets
description: Support agents occasionally misclick and resolve open inquiries accidentally. A lightweight confirmation prompt would prevent accidental closures.

title: Webhook payload missing signature header for verification
description: Our security gateway rejects incoming webhook events because the X-Hub-Signature-256 header is absent in the staging environment.

title: Request for custom domain mapping on status page
description: We would like to point status.ourcompany.com directly to our public support ticket incident board via CNAME record.

title: Session expires without warning after 30 minutes of inactivity
description: Agents drafting long ticket replies lose their unsaved drafts if they step away for lunch. Adding an autosave or idle warning popup would save hours of work.

title: PDF receipts missing company tax registration number
description: Under French commercial law, invoices must state the SIRET number and RCS city. Please update the European billing template.

title: Critical: DB connection pool exhaustion during peak traffic
description: Connection pool reached max 50 connections on Monday morning, resulting in connection acquired timeouts. Pool size and connection timeout configuration adjusted.
